items.title: Claudini: Autoresearch Discovers State-of-the-Art Adversarial Attack Algorithms for LLMs
items.title_zh: Claudini：Autoresearch 自动发现 LLM 最先进对抗攻击算法
items.summary: The authors deploy frontier coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex in an autoresearch loop with access to 30+ prior attack methods and a fixed compute budget. The discovered methods reached up to 80% attack success on CBRN queries against GPT-OSS-Safeguard-20B, versus under 50% for existing methods, and 100% ASR on prompt injection against Meta-SecAlign-70B.

items.title: AVO: Agentic Variation Operators for Autonomous Evolutionary Search
items.title_zh: AVO：自主进化搜索的智能体变异算子
items.summary: Agentic Variation Operators replace fixed mutation and crossover heuristics with a self-directed coding-agent loop that consults lineage, a domain knowledge base and execution feedback to propose, repair and verify edits. Over seven days of autonomous evolution on NVIDIA B200 GPUs, AVO discovered attention kernels outperforming cuDNN by up to 3.5% and FlashAttention-4 by up to 10.5%.

items.title: AIP: Agent Identity Protocol for Verifiable Delegation Across MCP and A2A
items.title_zh: AIP：跨 MCP 与 A2A 的可验证委托智能体身份协议
items.summary: AIP introduces Invocation-Bound Capability Tokens that bind identity, attenuated authorization and provenance into an append-only token chain, with JWT compact mode and Biscuit/Datalog chained mode for multi-hop delegation. A scan of about 2,000 MCP servers found none with authentication; AIP adds about 0.22 ms over no-auth in an MCP-over-HTTP deployment and rejected all 600 adversarial attempts.

items.title: MARCH: Multi-Agent Reinforced Self-Check for LLM Hallucination
items.title_zh: MARCH：面向 LLM 幻觉的多智能体强化自检框架
items.summary: MARCH orchestrates a Solver, a Proposer and a Checker, with the Checker validating claim-level propositions against retrieved evidence in isolation from the Solver's original output to break confirmation bias. Trained with multi-agent reinforcement learning, an 8B-parameter model using MARCH is reported as competitive with powerful closed-source models on hallucination benchmarks.

items.title: Context-Mediated Domain Adaptation in Multi-Agent Sensemaking Systems
items.title_zh: 多智能体意义建构系统中的上下文中介领域自适应
items.summary: The authors propose context-mediated domain adaptation, in which user edits to system-generated artifacts act as implicit domain specifications that reshape multi-agent LLM reasoning. Their Seedentia system creates bidirectional semantic links between artifacts and reasoning; an expert evaluation extracted 46 domain knowledge entries from user modifications, though the small sample limits conclusions about systematic quality gains.

items.title: AutoSAM: an Agentic Framework for Automating Input File Generation for the SAM Code with Multi-Modal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.title_zh: AutoSAM：结合多模态 RAG 自动生成 SAM 输入文件的智能体框架
items.summary: AutoSAM is an agentic framework that combines an LLM agent with retrieval over the SAM solver's user guide and theory manual, plus tools for PDFs, images, spreadsheets and text. Across four reactor case studies it produced runnable SAM models, reached 100% utilization of structured inputs, about 88% extraction from PDF text and 100% completeness in vision-based geometric extraction.

items.title: Secure On-Premise Deployment of Open-Weights Large Language Models in Radiology: An Isolation-First Architecture with Prospective Pilot Evaluation
items.title_zh: 放射科开放权重大模型的安全本地部署：隔离优先架构与前瞻性试点评估
items.summary: The paper describes an isolation-first, containerized deployment of the open-weights DeepSeek-R1 model via vLLM for a German university hospital, using network segmentation and egress filtering. In a one-week pilot with 22 residents and radiologists, text-anchored tasks such as report corrections received the highest utility ratings, while open-ended conclusion generation produced the most critical errors.

items.title: LensWalk: Agentic Video Understanding by Planning How You See in Videos
items.title_zh: LensWalk：通过规划观看方式实现智能体式视频理解
items.summary: LensWalk is an agentic framework that lets an LLM reasoner control its own visual observation of video, specifying the temporal scope and sampling density at each step in a reason-plan-observe loop. Without model fine-tuning it boosts accuracy by over 5% on long-video benchmarks including LVBench and Video-MME.

items.title: SentinelAI: A Multi-Agent Framework for Structuring and Linking NG9-1-1 Emergency Incident Data
items.title_zh: SentinelAI：面向 NG9-1-1 应急事件数据结构化与关联的多智能体框架
items.summary: SentinelAI is a multi-agent data integration and standardization framework that turns emergency communications into standardized, machine-readable datasets. Its EIDO Agent ingests raw communications and produces NENA-compliant Emergency Incident Data Object JSON.

items.title: Mininglamp-AI/Mano-P
items.title_zh: Mininglamp-AI/Mano-P：面向边缘设备的开源 GUI-VLA 智能体
items.summary: Mano-P is an open-source GUI-VLA agent for edge devices that runs locally on Apple M4 Mac mini and MacBook hardware, keeps data on the device, and ranks first on the specialized OSWorld track at 58.2%.

items.title: larksuite/cli
items.summary: The official Lark/Feishu CLI, maintained by the larksuite team, is built for humans and AI agents and covers Messenger, Docs, Base, Sheets, Calendar, Mail, Tasks and Meetings through more than 200 commands and 20+ agent skills.
